capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Kia UK spec page: 58.3 kWh (bare capacity = gross; usable not stated). North America lists the same pack sizes (Electrek, Auto123, Guide Auto).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: no page states EV3/EV4 usable kWh. 58.3 x 54.0/57.7 (the 58 kWh E-GMP pack: 54.0 usable of 57.7 nominal, EV Database); a different cell supplier or pack design is possible. Treat as approximate.

chemistry.notes: Wikipedia: the EV3 (and EV4, same E-GMP 58.3/81.4 kWh packs) use NMC lithium-ion packs.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Kia UK: nominal 369 V (400 V E-GMP, also stated by Guide Auto and InsideEVs).

preconditioning.notes: Kia UK page names the EV3: setting a public charger as the destination starts warming/cooling the battery on the drive, and it can also be started from the infotainment or Kia Connect app. UK page; no North American page read.

ac_max_kw.notes: Kia UK: 11 kW AC (230 V 16 A, European spec). No North American page states the onboard charger; assumed unchanged.

dc_max_kw.notes: Kia UK spec: 101 kW DC (page ties it to the 10-80 % time; Fastned lists 100 kW). UK spec; same pack in North America.

published_10_80_min.notes: Kia figure: about 29 minutes 10-80 % on a 350 kW charger (relayed; Kia UK says 29 min too).
